proposal: One source expression in down_action_impl: form the fallback pr/na only when sum>1e-12f is false; initialize the otherwise unused uni to0. The original per-action condition, division operands, stores and loop order remain unchanged.
compiled_baseline_observation: Accepted E051 down_action PTX has pr/3 before the sum-threshold branch and pr/na before the generic action loop. Common2/4 paths use selected constant fractions. Compiler may speculate or transform the candidate back; a real compiled body difference is required, and no division saving or speedup is assumed.
semantic_argument: If sum>1e-12f, every unlocked action writes pr*((r>0?r:0)/sum) and never consumes uni; changing that unused scalar to0 does not change any stored value.
Otherwise, including unordered sum, source evaluates the identical pr/(float)na expression and writes the original uni for every action. No reciprocal substitution or reassociation is proposed.

Locked path, regret loads, ordered positive-regret sum, threshold, parent reach, child addresses, common2/3/4/generic dispatch and all other entries unchanged. No new storage, host/ABI/layout/graph/launch/precision/quality setting.

GPU floating operations that produce stored results retain original expressions and order; exact direct device controls including signedzero/nonfinite/extremes and full solver state/checkpoint qualification remain required before any adoption.
